about: Fixture set for the alignment signal prompt (alignment-signal@1), from the fictional Riverside engagement. The case has the inputs ai_claim hands the worker for the alignment_signal job and the reply recorded for the fake client. The reply holds two cards the parser must drop (an unknown kind, an unknown theme), an unknown room ref and an unknown also ref. The room's own text holds an instruction, which is data.
